core_obligations: Show that the multiplicity m_{Z', Z_K} of an irreducible component Z' of the base change of an integral locally algebraic k-scheme Z by a field extension K/k is one or a power of the characteristic of k (proof lines 311-361). First, if the characteristic of k is zero, k is perfect and the base change is reduced by varieties-lemma-geometrically-reduced (tag 035X), so every multiplicity is one; in characteristic p > 0, with L the function field of Z, the tensor product K tensor_k L is Noetherian (Algebra lemma on Noetherianity of field extensions) and the question becomes the assertion that the length of the artinian local ring (K tensor_k L)_q is a power of p for every minimal prime q (proof lines 311-322). Second, for a finite purely inseparable extension L'/L of degree p^n, the ring map K tensor_k L into K tensor_k L' is finite free of rank p^n, induces a homeomorphism on spectra with purely inseparable residue field extensions, so each minimal prime q lies under a unique minimal prime q', and the pushdown formula of algebra-lemma-pushdown-module (tag 02M0) applied to the free module of rank p^n gives p^n times the length at q equal to the residue field degree times the length at q'; since the residue field degree is a power of p, it suffices to prove the statement for L' and q' (proof lines 324-342). Third, by algebra-lemma-make-separable (tag 030R) assume L/k'/k with L/k' separable and k'/k finite purely inseparable; K tensor_k k' is artinian local and the preceding paragraph with L = k, L' = k' shows its length is a power of p; L/k' is the localization of a smooth k'-algebra by algebra-lemma-localization-smooth-separable (tag 037X), so S = (K tensor_k L)_q is the localization at a minimal prime of a smooth R = K tensor_k k'-algebra; the map R to S is a flat local homomorphism of artinian local rings with m_R S = m_S, and algebra-lemma-pullback-module (tag 02M1) gives length(K tensor_k k') = length(R) = length(S) = length((K tensor_k L)_q), finishing the proof (proof lines 344-360).
proof_roadmap: Characteristic zero: perfectness and geometric reducedness give multiplicity one; characteristic p: reduce to lengths of artinian local rings at minimal primes (proof lines 311-322).
Purely inseparable descent: pushdown formula with p-power residue degrees lets one pass to a finite purely inseparable extension of the function field (proof lines 324-342).

Split the extension: purely inseparable part gives an artinian local ring of p-power length, separable part is a smooth localization, and the pullback formula transports the length (proof lines 344-360).
